title: Blockworks: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Blockworks loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Start by standardizing floors, walls, power lanes, and route markers. Consistent materials make hazard exits and storage zones obvious under stress.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: Start with readable lanes: one floor language for movement, one wall language for safety, and one visible service lane for machines or cables.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Blockworks is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
